Callout.Name: Counterfeit Currency
Callout.Message: Shop reporting a customer passing counterfeit notes.
Callout.Advisory: Customer still in the shop, staff holding the note.

Script.Line: That is the note they gave me in the change. I am not the one making them.
The machine took it. Why would I hand over a note the machine takes?
Check the wallet. If there are more of them in there, charge me.

Lines.Approach: Staff have the note and the customer is still in there. They want a report, not a scene.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
